author: Periodic Videos
description:
We discuss the discovery of a new buckyball - this one made of Boron. For more details the full interview with Professor Wang can be found at https://youtu.be/kMWm0Sl6cDY. More links and info in full description ↓↓↓

Discussed by our very own Professor Martyn Poliakoff, plus the lead researcher Lai-Sheng Wang.

Lai-Sheng Wang is based at Brown University. His research was supported by the US National Science Foundation.

The paper Boron buckminsterfullerene : https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2026/sc/d6sc02674e
